difficultyRationale: Tests both the success condition and side effect of an atomic compare-and-set operation.
explanation: The AtomicInteger starts at 10. `compareAndSet(10, 20)` observes the expected value, updates it to 20, and returns true.

options.explanation: The expected value matches, so the update succeeds and the new value is 20.
That would happen if the expected value did not match.
A successful compareAndSet also updates the stored value.
A false result means the update did not occur.
